+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class RegimeBasedVolatilityStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (('base_size', 1.0),)
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+        self.bbands = bt.indicators.BollingerBands(
+            self.data.close, period=20, devfactor=2
+        )
+        self.bb_width = self.bbands.top - self.bbands.bot
+        self.atr_ema = bt.indicators.EMA(self.atr, period=50)
+        self.bb_width_ema = bt.indicators.EMA(self.bb_width, period=50)
+        self.ema10 = bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=10)
+        self.ema30 = bt.indicators.EMA(self.data.close, period=30)
+        self.sma50 = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=50)
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
+        self.macd = bt.indicators.MACDHisto(
+            self.data.close, period_me1=12, period_me2=26, period_signal=9
+        )
+        self.ema_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.ema10, self.ema30)
+        self.cvi = (0.5 * (self.atr / self.atr_ema) +
+                    0.5 * (self.bb_width / self.bb_width_ema))
+        self.cvi_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.cvi, 1.0)
+        self.macd_hist_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.macd.histo, 0.0)
+        self.rsi_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.rsi, 50.0)
+        self.j = self.atr / self.bb_width
+
+        self.order = None
+        self.pending_trade_type = None
+        self.pending_stop_distance = None
+        self.trade_type = None
+        self.stop_price = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy():
+                self.trade_type = self.pending_trade_type
+                self.stop_price = (order.executed.price -
+                                   self.pending_stop_distance)
+            elif order.issell() and not self.position:
+                self.trade_type = None
+                self.stop_price = None
+            self.order = None
+            self.pending_trade_type = None
+            self.pending_stop_distance = None
+        elif order.status in (order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.order = None
+            self.pending_trade_type = None
+            self.pending_stop_distance = None
+
+    def _size(self):
+        if self.cvi[0] < 0.9:
+            multiplier = 1.3
+        elif self.cvi[0] > 1.1:
+            multiplier = 0.7
+        else:
+            multiplier = 1.0
+        return self.p.base_size * multiplier
+
+    def _enter_long(self, trade_type, stop_multiple):
+        self.pending_trade_type = trade_type
+        self.pending_stop_distance = stop_multiple * self.atr[0]
+        self.order = self.buy(size=self._size())
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        if self.position:
+            exit_signal = False
+
+            if self.trade_type == 'low':
+                exit_signal = (self.cvi_cross[0] > 0 or
+                               self.data.close[0] <= self.stop_price)
+            elif self.trade_type == 'high':
+                exit_signal = (self.cvi_cross[0] < 0 or
+                               self.data.close[0] <= self.stop_price or
+                               self.data.close[0] >= self.bbands.mid[0] or
+                               self.rsi[0] > 55)
+            elif self.trade_type == 'shift_up':
+                exit_signal = (self.cvi_cross[0] < 0 or
+                               self.data.close[0] <= self.stop_price)
+
+            # Each daily input bar is the complete trading day, so an open
+            # position is closed after evaluating that day's other exits.
+            exit_signal = True
+            if exit_signal:
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        shift_up = (self.cvi_cross[0] > 0 and
+                    self.macd_hist_cross[0] > 0 and
+                    self.rsi_cross[0] > 0 and
+                    self.rsi[0] > 50 and
+                    self.data.close[0] > self.sma50[0])
+
+        if shift_up:
+            self._enter_long('shift_up', 2.5)
+        elif (self.cvi[0] < 0.9 and
+              self.ema_cross[0] > 0 and
+              self.data.close[0] > self.sma50[0] and
+              self.rsi[0] > 50):
+            self._enter_long('low', 1.5)
+        elif (self.cvi[0] > 1.1 and
+              self.data.low[0] <= self.bbands.bot[0] and
+              self.rsi[0] < 35):
+            self._enter_long('high', 2.5)
+```

+import backtrader as bt
+import math
+
+
+class PeriodicTargetWeightStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ("target_weights", ()),
+        ("rebalancing_period", "quarterly"),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        if self.p.rebalancing_period not in ("quarterly", "yearly"):
+            raise ValueError("rebalancing_period must be 'quarterly' or 'yearly'")
+
+        self.order = None
+        self._period = None
+        self._weight_index = 0
+        self.broker.setcommission(commission=0.001)
+        self.broker.set_slippage_perc(perc=0.0005)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            self.order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        current_date = self.data.datetime.date(0)
+        current_price = self.data.close[0]
+        if not math.isfinite(current_price) or current_price <= 0:
+            return
+
+        if self.p.rebalancing_period == "quarterly":
+            current_period = (current_date.year, (current_date.month - 1) // 3)
+        else:
+            current_period = current_date.year
+
+        if current_period == self._period:
+            return
+
+        self._period = current_period
+        if self._weight_index >= len(self.p.target_weights):
+            return
+
+        target_weight = self.p.target_weights[self._weight_index]
+        self._weight_index += 1
+        if not 0.0 <= target_weight <= 1.0:
+            raise ValueError("target weights must be in the range [0, 1]")
+        if self.order is not None:
+            return
+
+        if target_weight == 0:
+            if self.position:
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        target_shares = int(
+            (self.broker.getvalue() * target_weight) / current_price
+        )
+        if target_shares != self.position.size:
+            self.order = self.order_target_size(target=target_shares)

+import backtrader as bt
+import math
+
+
+class BreakoutAfterDoubleBottom(bt.Strategy):
+    params = (
+        ('support', 135.0),
+        ('bottom_tolerance', 0.1),
+        ('resistance', 191.8),
+        ('stop_price', 132.3),
+        ('volume_period', 20),
+        ('volume_multiplier', 1.2),
+        ('risk_fraction', 0.015),
+        ('consolidation_low', 134.2),
+        ('consolidation_period', 20),
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.volume_average = bt.indicators.SMA(
+            self.data.volume, period=self.p.volume_period
+        )
+        self.addminperiod(self.p.consolidation_period + 2)
+        self.entry_order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+        self.take_profit_order = None
+        self.close_order = None
+        self.first_bottom = None
+        self.intervening_local_high = False
+        self.pattern_low = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        terminal = order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        )
+        if not terminal:
+            return
+
+        if order is self.entry_order:
+            self.entry_order = None
+        if order is self.stop_order:
+            self.stop_order = None
+        if order is self.take_profit_order:
+            self.take_profit_order = None
+        if order is self.close_order:
+            self.close_order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        pivot_date = self.data.datetime.date(-1)
+        pivot_low = self.data.low[-1]
+        is_local_low = pivot_low < self.data.low[-2] and pivot_low < self.data.low[0]
+        is_local_high = (
+            self.data.high[-1] > self.data.high[-2]
+            and self.data.high[-1] > self.data.high[0]
+        )
+        in_bottom_zone = (
+            self.p.support - self.p.bottom_tolerance
+            <= pivot_low
+            <= self.p.support + self.p.bottom_tolerance
+        )
+
+        if self.first_bottom is not None and is_local_high:
+            self.intervening_local_high = True
+
+        if is_local_low and in_bottom_zone and pivot_date.year >= 2023:
+            after_october_2023 = (
+                pivot_date.year > 2023
+                or (pivot_date.year == 2023 and pivot_date.month > 10)
+            )
+            if self.first_bottom is None:
+                consolidation = all(
+                    self.p.consolidation_low
+                    <= self.data.close[-offset]
+                    <= self.p.resistance
+                    for offset in range(2, self.p.consolidation_period + 2)
+                )
+                if after_october_2023 and consolidation:
+                    self.first_bottom = pivot_low
+                    self.intervening_local_high = False
+            elif self.intervening_local_high:
+                self.pattern_low = min(self.first_bottom, pivot_low)
+                self.first_bottom = pivot_low
+                self.intervening_local_high = False
+
+        if self.position:
+            if (
+                self.data.close[0] < self.p.support
+                and self.close_order is None
+            ):
+                if self.stop_order is not None:
+                    self.cancel(self.stop_order)
+                if self.take_profit_order is not None:
+                    self.cancel(self.take_profit_order)
+                self.close_order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        if self.entry_order is not None or self.close_order is not None:
+            return
+
+        breakout = (
+            self.data.close[-1] <= self.p.resistance
+            and self.data.close[0] > self.p.resistance
+        )
+        volume_confirmed = (
+            self.data.volume[0]
+            >= self.p.volume_multiplier * self.volume_average[0]
+        )
+        if self.pattern_low is not None and breakout and volume_confirmed:
+            risk_per_share = self.data.close[0] - self.p.stop_price
+            risk_capital = self.p.risk_fraction * self.broker.getvalue()
+            size = math.floor(risk_capital / risk_per_share)
+            if size > 0:
+                pattern_height = self.p.resistance - self.pattern_low
+                take_profit = self.p.resistance + pattern_height
+                orders = self.buy_bracket(
+                    size=size,
+                    exectype=bt.Order.Market,
+                    stopprice=self.p.stop_price,
+                    limitprice=take_profit,
+                )
+                self.entry_order, self.stop_order, self.take_profit_order = orders

+class FiftyTwoWeekHighStopStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.high_52_week = bt.indicators.Highest(self.data.close, period=252)
+        self.prior_high_52_week = bt.indicators.Highest(
+            self.data.close(-1), period=252
+        )
+        self.breakout = bt.indicators.CrossOver(
+            self.data.close, self.prior_high_52_week
+        )
+        self.entry_order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+        self.stop_high = None
+        self.replacement_high = None
+
+    def _place_stop_limit(self, high):
+        self.stop_high = high
+        self.stop_order = self.sell(
+            size=self.position.size,
+            exectype=bt.Order.StopLimit,
+            price=0.95 * high,
+            plimit=0.90 * high,
+        )
+
+    def _entry_size(self):
+        cash = self.broker.getcash()
+        price = float(self.data.close[0])
+        commission_info = self.broker.getcommissioninfo(self.data)
+        size = int(cash / price)
+        while size > 0:
+            cost = commission_info.getoperationcost(size, price)
+            commission = commission_info.getcommission(size, price)
+            if cost + commission <= cash:
+                return size
+            size -= 1
+        return 0
+
+    def next(self):
+        if not self.position:
+            if self.entry_order is None and self.stop_order is None:
+                if self.breakout[0] > 0:
+                    size = self._entry_size()
+                    if size > 0:
+                        self.entry_order = self.buy(size=size)
+            return
+
+        current_high = float(self.high_52_week[0])
+        if self.stop_order is None:
+            self._place_stop_limit(current_high)
+        elif current_high != self.stop_high:
+            self.replacement_high = current_high
+            self.cancel(self.stop_order)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (order.Submitted, order.Accepted):
+            return
+
+        if order is self.entry_order:
+            if order.status == order.Completed and self.position:
+                self._place_stop_limit(float(self.high_52_week[0]))
+            self.entry_order = None
+            return
+
+        if order is self.stop_order:
+            self.stop_order = None
+            self.stop_high = None
+            if order.status == order.Canceled and self.position:
+                high = self.replacement_high
+                if high is None:
+                    high = float(self.high_52_week[0])
+                self.replacement_high = None
+                self._place_stop_limit(high)
+            else:
+                self.replacement_high = None

+class OpeningRangeRelativeVolumeStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = ()
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.volume_sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.volume, period=20)
+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
+        self.rsi_cross = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.rsi, 50.0)
+

+        self.trailing_stop = None
+        self.session_date = None
+        self.opening_bar_count = 0
+        self.opening_range_high = None
+        self.opening_range_low = None
+
+    def _in_regular_hours(self):
+        bar_time = self.data.datetime.time(0)
+        return ((bar_time.hour > 9 or
+                 (bar_time.hour == 9 and bar_time.minute >= 30)) and
+                bar_time.hour < 16)
+
+    def _update_opening_range(self):
+        if not self._in_regular_hours():
+            return
+
+        bar_date = self.data.datetime.date(0)
+        if bar_date != self.session_date:
+            self.session_date = bar_date
+            self.opening_bar_count = 0
+            self.opening_range_high = None
+            self.opening_range_low = None
+
+        if self.opening_bar_count < 4:
+            high = self.data.high[0]
+            low = self.data.low[0]
+            if self.opening_bar_count == 0:
+                self.opening_range_high = high
+                self.opening_range_low = low
+            else:
+                self.opening_range_high = max(self.opening_range_high, high)
+                self.opening_range_low = min(self.opening_range_low, low)
+            self.opening_bar_count += 1
+
+    def prenext(self):
+        self._update_opening_range()
+
+    def next(self):
+        self._update_opening_range()
+
+        if (not self._in_regular_hours() or
+                self.opening_bar_count < 4 or
+                self.order is not None):
+            return
+
+        relative_volume = self.data.volume[0] / self.volume_sma[0]
+        high_relative_volume = relative_volume > 1.5
+        long_breakout = (self.data.close[0] > self.opening_range_high and
+                         high_relative_volume)
+        short_breakout = (self.data.close[0] < self.opening_range_low and
+                          high_relative_volume)
+
+        if not self.position:
+            if long_breakout:
+                self.order = self.buy()
+            elif short_breakout:
+                self.order = self.sell()
+        elif self.position.size > 0:
+            if self.rsi_cross[0] < 0 or short_breakout:
+                if self.trailing_stop is not None:
+                    self.cancel(self.trailing_stop)
+                self.order = self.close()
+        elif self.position.size < 0:
+            if self.rsi_cross[0] > 0 or long_breakout:
+                if self.trailing_stop is not None:
+                    self.cancel(self.trailing_stop)
+                self.order = self.close()
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        terminal = (order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin,
+                    order.Rejected)
+        if order.status not in terminal:
+            return
+
+        if order is self.trailing_stop:
+            self.trailing_stop = None
+            return
+
+        if order is not self.order:
+            return
+
+        self.order = None
+        if order.status != order.Completed:
+            return
+
+        if not self.position:
+            if self.trailing_stop is not None:
+                self.cancel(self.trailing_stop)
+            return
+

+                    trailamount=trail_amount)

+class ReferenceStrategy(bt.Strategy):

+        self.volume_sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.volume, period=20)

+        self.entry_price = None
+        self.entry_bar = None
+        self.entry_k = None
+        self.protection_active = False
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            if order.isbuy():
+                self.entry_price = order.executed.price
+                self.entry_bar = len(self)
+                self.entry_k = order.info.get("entry_k")
+                self.protection_active = False
+            else:
+                self.entry_price = None
+                self.entry_bar = None
+                self.entry_k = None
+                self.protection_active = False
+            self.order = None
+        elif order.status in (order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order:
+            return
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        atr = float(self.atr[0])
+        k = max(0.01, min(atr / close, 0.05))
+        liquid = self.data.volume[0] > self.volume_sma[0]
+
+        if not self.position:
+            if self.p.strategy == "csp":
+                if (
+                    close < self.bollinger.bot[0]
+                    and self.rsi[0] < 35
+                    and liquid
+                ):
+                    limit_price = close * (1.0 - k)
+                    size = int((self.broker.getvalue() * 0.20) / limit_price)
+                    if size > 0:
+                        self.order = self.buy(
+                            exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                            price=limit_price,
+                            size=size,
+                        )
+                        self.order.addinfo(entry_k=k)
+            elif self.p.strategy == "cc":
+                if self.cross[0] > 0 and close > self.ema[0] and liquid:
+                    size = int(self.broker.getvalue() / close)
+                    if size > 0:
+                        self.order = self.buy(size=size)
+                        self.order.addinfo(entry_k=k)
+            return
+
+        held_bars = len(self) - self.entry_bar
+
+        if self.p.strategy == "csp":
+            fixed_profit = self.entry_price + 0.5 * self.entry_k * self.entry_price
+            take_profit = max(fixed_profit, float(self.bollinger.mid[0]))

+            protection_level = (

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class LongTermMeanReversion(bt.Strategy):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.bollinger = bt.indicators.BollingerBands(
+            self.data.close, period=120, devfactor=2
+        )
+        self.rsi = bt.indicators.RSI(self.data.close, period=14)
+        self.volume_sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.volume, period=20)
+        self.atr = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+        self.atr_sma = bt.indicators.SMA(self.atr, period=50)
+
+        self.entry_order = None
+        self.exit_order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+        self.entry_atr = None
+        self.entry_bar = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        terminal = order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        )
+        if not terminal:
+            return
+
+        if order is self.entry_order:
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                self.entry_bar = len(self)
+                distance = 2 * self.entry_atr
+                if order.isbuy():
+                    stop_price = order.executed.price - distance
+                    self.stop_order = self.sell(
+                        size=abs(self.position.size),
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                        price=stop_price,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    stop_price = order.executed.price + distance
+                    self.stop_order = self.buy(
+                        size=abs(self.position.size),
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                        price=stop_price,
+                    )
+            self.entry_order = None
+            self.entry_atr = None
+        elif order is self.exit_order:
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                self.entry_bar = None
+            self.exit_order = None
+        elif order is self.stop_order:
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                self.entry_bar = None
+            self.stop_order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.entry_order is not None or self.exit_order is not None:
+            return
+
+        lower_cross_up = (
+            self.data.close[-1] < self.bollinger.bot[-1]
+            and self.data.close[0] >= self.bollinger.bot[0]
+        )
+        rsi_cross_30_up = self.rsi[-1] < 30 and self.rsi[0] >= 30
+        upper_cross_down = (
+            self.data.close[-1] > self.bollinger.top[-1]
+            and self.data.close[0] <= self.bollinger.top[0]
+        )
+        rsi_cross_70_down = self.rsi[-1] > 70 and self.rsi[0] <= 70
+
+        long_signal = lower_cross_up or rsi_cross_30_up
+        short_signal = upper_cross_down or rsi_cross_70_down
+        filters_pass = (
+            self.data.volume[0] > self.volume_sma[0]
+            and self.atr[0] < self.atr_sma[0] * 1.5
+        )
+
+        if not self.position:
+            if self.stop_order is not None:
+                return
+            if filters_pass and long_signal:
+                self.entry_atr = self.atr[0]
+                self.entry_order = self.buy()
+            elif filters_pass and short_signal:
+                self.entry_atr = self.atr[0]
+                self.entry_order = self.sell()
+            return
+
+        held_for_20_bars = (
+            self.entry_bar is not None and len(self) - self.entry_bar >= 20
+        )
+        if self.position.size > 0:
+            returned_to_middle = self.data.close[0] >= self.bollinger.mid[0]
+            opposite_signal = short_signal
+        else:
+            returned_to_middle = self.data.close[0] <= self.bollinger.mid[0]
+            opposite_signal = long_signal
+
+        if returned_to_middle or held_for_20_bars or opposite_signal:
+            if self.stop_order is not None:
+                self.cancel(self.stop_order)
+            self.exit_order = self.close()

+                if (not self.trailing_active and

+                    self.trailing_stop = self.favorable_price - atr
+                elif self.trailing_active:

+                stop_hit = self.data.low[0] <= standard_stop
+                trailing_hit = (self.trailing_active and
+                                self.data.low[0] <= self.trailing_stop)
+            else:
+                self.favorable_price = min(self.favorable_price, self.data.low[0])
+                if (not self.trailing_active and

+                    self.trailing_stop = self.favorable_price + atr
+                elif self.trailing_active:

+        if not volatility_allowed:

+        atr = self.atr[0]

+        size = math.floor(

+        elif (crossed_below and self.data.close[0] < self.sma[0] and

+import backtrader as bt
+
+
+class SupplyDemandSwingStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.order = None
+        self.stop_order = None
+        self.limit_order = None
+        self.pending_stop = None
+        self.pending_target = None
+        self.four_hour_bars = []
+        self.daily_bars = []
+        self.demand_zones = []
+        self.supply_zones = []
+        self.current_four_hour = None
+        self.current_day = None
+        self.daily_trend = 0
+
+    def _start_bar(self):
+        return {
+            'open': float(self.data.open[0]),
+            'high': float(self.data.high[0]),
+            'low': float(self.data.low[0]),
+            'close': float(self.data.close[0]),
+            'volume': float(self.data.volume[0]),
+        }
+
+    def _update_bar(self, bar):
+        bar['high'] = max(bar['high'], float(self.data.high[0]))
+        bar['low'] = min(bar['low'], float(self.data.low[0]))
+        bar['close'] = float(self.data.close[0])
+        bar['volume'] += float(self.data.volume[0])
+
+    def _record_zones(self, bars, timeframe):
+        if len(bars) < 4:
+            return
+        consolidation = bars[-4:-1]
+        impulse = bars[-1]
+        lower = min(bar['low'] for bar in consolidation)
+        upper = max(bar['high'] for bar in consolidation)
+        reference_price = impulse['close']
+        if upper - lower < 0.005 * reference_price:
+            return
+        average_volume = sum(bar['volume'] for bar in consolidation) / 3.0
+        if impulse['volume'] <= average_volume:
+            return
+        if impulse['close'] - upper >= 0.01 * reference_price:
+            self.demand_zones.append({
+                'lower': lower, 'upper': upper, 'timeframe': timeframe
+            })
+        if lower - impulse['close'] >= 0.01 * reference_price:
+            self.supply_zones.append({
+                'lower': lower, 'upper': upper, 'timeframe': timeframe
+            })
+
+    def _finish_four_hour(self):
+        self.four_hour_bars.append(self.current_four_hour)
+        self._record_zones(self.four_hour_bars, '4H')
+
+    def _finish_day(self):
+        self.daily_bars.append(self.current_day)
+        self._record_zones(self.daily_bars, '1D')
+        if len(self.daily_bars) >= 2:
+            previous = self.daily_bars[-2]['close']
+            current = self.daily_bars[-1]['close']
+            self.daily_trend = 1 if current > previous else -1 if current < previous else 0
+
+    def _aggregate(self):
+        timestamp = self.data.datetime.datetime(0)
+        four_hour_key = (timestamp.date(), timestamp.hour // 4)
+        day_key = timestamp.date()
+
+        if self.current_four_hour is None:
+            self.current_four_hour = self._start_bar()
+            self.current_four_hour_key = four_hour_key
+        elif four_hour_key != self.current_four_hour_key:
+            self._finish_four_hour()
+            self.current_four_hour = self._start_bar()
+            self.current_four_hour_key = four_hour_key
+        else:
+            self._update_bar(self.current_four_hour)
+
+        if self.current_day is None:
+            self.current_day = self._start_bar()
+            self.current_day_key = day_key
+        elif day_key != self.current_day_key:
+            self._finish_day()
+            self.current_day = self._start_bar()
+            self.current_day_key = day_key
+        else:
+            self._update_bar(self.current_day)
+
+    def _long_zone(self):
+        low = float(self.data.low[0])
+        high = float(self.data.high[0])
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        candidates = []
+        for zone in self.demand_zones:
+            middle = (zone['lower'] + zone['upper']) / 2.0
+            if low <= zone['upper'] and high >= zone['lower'] and low <= middle and close > middle:
+                candidates.append(zone)
+        return max(candidates, key=lambda zone: zone['upper']) if candidates else None
+
+    def _short_zone(self):
+        low = float(self.data.low[0])
+        high = float(self.data.high[0])
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        candidates = []
+        for zone in self.supply_zones:
+            middle = (zone['lower'] + zone['upper']) / 2.0
+            if low <= zone['upper'] and high >= zone['lower'] and high >= middle and close < middle:
+                candidates.append(zone)
+        return min(candidates, key=lambda zone: zone['lower']) if candidates else None
+
+    def _size_for_risk(self, entry, stop):
+        risk_per_unit = abs(entry - stop)
+        if risk_per_unit == 0.0:
+            return 0
+        return int((self.broker.getvalue() * 0.01) / risk_per_unit)
+
+    def next(self):
+        self._aggregate()
+        if self.order or self.stop_order or self.limit_order or self.position:
+            return
+
+        close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        if self.daily_trend > 0:
+            zone = self._long_zone()
+            if zone is None:
+                return
+            stop = zone['lower'] * 0.995
+            higher_supplies = [z for z in self.supply_zones if z['lower'] > close]
+            target = (min(higher_supplies, key=lambda z: z['lower'])['lower']
+                      if higher_supplies else close + 2.0 * (close - stop))
+            size = self._size_for_risk(close, stop)
+            if size > 0:
+                self.pending_stop = stop
+                self.pending_target = target
+                self.order = self.buy(size=size)
+        elif self.daily_trend < 0:
+            zone = self._short_zone()
+            if zone is None:
+                return
+            stop = zone['upper'] * 1.005
+            lower_demands = [z for z in self.demand_zones if z['upper'] < close]
+            target = (max(lower_demands, key=lambda z: z['upper'])['upper']
+                      if lower_demands else close - 2.0 * (stop - close))
+            size = self._size_for_risk(close, stop)
+            if size > 0:
+                self.pending_stop = stop
+                self.pending_target = target
+                self.order = self.sell(size=size)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (order.Submitted, order.Accepted):
+            return
+
+        if order is self.order:
+            self.order = None
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                if order.isbuy():
+                    self.stop_order = self.sell(
+                        size=order.executed.size, exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                        price=self.pending_stop
+                    )
+                    self.limit_order = self.sell(
+                        size=order.executed.size, exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                        price=self.pending_target, oco=self.stop_order
+                    )
+                else:
+                    size = abs(order.executed.size)
+                    self.stop_order = self.buy(
+                        size=size, exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                        price=self.pending_stop
+                    )
+                    self.limit_order = self.buy(
+                        size=size, exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                        price=self.pending_target, oco=self.stop_order
+                    )
+            else:
+                self.pending_stop = None
+                self.pending_target = None
+            return
+
+        if order is self.stop_order and order.status in (
+                order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.stop_order = None
+        if order is self.limit_order and order.status in (
+                order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected):
+            self.limit_order = None
+        if order.status == order.Completed:
+            self.pending_stop = None
+            self.pending_target = None

+class ReferenceStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.sma10 = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=10)
+        self.sma20 = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=20)
+        self.atr14 = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)
+        self.crossover = bt.indicators.CrossOver(self.sma10, self.sma20)
+        self.order = None
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        if order.status in (
+            order.Completed,
+            order.Canceled,
+            order.Margin,
+            order.Rejected,
+        ):
+            self.order = None
+
+    def next(self):
+        if self.order is not None:
+            return
+
+        timestamp = self.data.datetime.datetime(0)
+        minutes = timestamp.hour * 60 + timestamp.minute
+        session_open = 9 * 60 + 30
+        first_entry_minute = session_open + 5
+        last_entry_minute = 16 * 60 - 30
+        forced_exit_minute = 16 * 60 - 5
+        in_regular_session = session_open <= minutes < 16 * 60
+
+        if self.position:
+            if in_regular_session and minutes >= forced_exit_minute:
+                self.order = self.close()
+                return
+
+            entry_price = self.position.price
+            if self.position.size > 0:
+                opposite_crossover = self.crossover[0] < 0
+                stop_loss = self.data.close[0] <= entry_price * (1.0 - 0.01)
+            else:
+                opposite_crossover = self.crossover[0] > 0
+                stop_loss = self.data.close[0] >= entry_price * (1.0 + 0.01)
+
+            if opposite_crossover or stop_loss:
+                self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        may_enter = (
+            in_regular_session
+            and minutes >= first_entry_minute
+            and minutes < last_entry_minute
+        )
+        if not may_enter:
+            return
+
+        price = self.data.close[0]
+        within_atr = abs(price - self.sma20[0]) <= 0.5 * self.atr14[0]
+        if not within_atr:
+            return
+
+        equity = self.broker.getvalue()
+        quantity = math.floor((equity * 0.01) / (price * 0.01))

+class RetestBrokenResistanceStrategy(bt.Strategy):
+    params = ()
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.sma50 = bt.indicators.SMA(self.data.close, period=50)
+        self.atr14 = bt.indicators.ATR(self.data, period=14)

+        self.exit_orders = []
+        self.stop_order = None
+        self.replacing_stop = False
+
+    def _is_pivot_high(self, ago):
+        value = self.data.high[ago]
+        return all(value > self.data.high[ago - offset] for offset in range(1, 4)) and all(
+            value > self.data.high[ago + offset] for offset in range(1, 4)
+        )
+
+    def _is_pivot_low(self, ago):
+        value = self.data.low[ago]
+        return all(value < self.data.low[ago - offset] for offset in range(1, 4)) and all(
+            value < self.data.low[ago + offset] for offset in range(1, 4)
+        )
+
+    def _cancel_exits(self, except_order=None):
+        for order in list(self.exit_orders):
+            if order is not except_order and order.alive():
+                self.cancel(order)
+
+    def _place_stop_for_position(self):
+        remaining = int(self.position.size)
+        if remaining > 0:
+            self.stop_order = self.sell(
+                size=remaining,
+                exectype=bt.Order.Stop,
+                price=self.entry_stop,
+            )
+            self.exit_orders.append(self.stop_order)
+
+    def notify_order(self, order):
+        terminal = [order.Completed, order.Canceled, order.Margin, order.Rejected]
+        if order.status not in terminal:
+            return
+
+        if order is self.entry_order:
+            if order.status == order.Completed:
+                entry = order.executed.price
+                quantity = abs(int(order.executed.size))
+                risk = entry - self.entry_stop
+                quarter = quantity // 4
+                self.exit_orders = []
+                for multiple in (2.0, 4.0, 6.0, 8.0):
+                    target = entry + multiple * risk
+                    limit_order = self.sell(
+                        size=quarter,
+                        exectype=bt.Order.Limit,
+                        price=target,
+                    )
+                    self.exit_orders.append(limit_order)
+                self._place_stop_for_position()
+            self.entry_order = None
+            return
+
+        if order not in self.exit_orders:
+            return
+
+        if order.status == order.Completed:

+                self._cancel_exits(except_order=order)
+                self.stop_order = None
+                self.replacing_stop = False
+            elif order is self.stop_order:
+                self._cancel_exits(except_order=order)
+                self.stop_order = None

+            prospective_stop = min(
+                fixed_stop, math.nextafter(self.lower_channel, -math.inf))
+            risk_per_share = close - prospective_stop
+            risk_cash = self.broker.getvalue() * self.p.risk_fraction
+            size = math.floor(risk_cash / risk_per_share) if risk_per_share > 0 else 0
+            affordable = math.floor(
+                self.broker.getcash() / (close * (1.0 + 0.001)))
+            size = min(size, affordable)
+            if size > 0:
+                self.order = self.buy(size=size)
+
+    def next(self):
+        dt = self.data.datetime.datetime(0)
+        if self.session_date != dt.date():
+            self._reset_session(dt.date())
+
+        if dt.hour == 9 and dt.minute == 55:
+            self.upper_channel = float(self.data.high[0])
+        if dt.hour == 10 and dt.minute == 0:
+            self.lower_channel = float(self.data.low[0])
+            channel_range = (self.upper_channel - self.lower_channel
+                             if self.upper_channel is not None else 0.0)
+            self.skip_day = (
+                self.upper_channel is not None
+                and channel_range / self.lower_channel
+                > self.p.volatile_channel_fraction
+            )
+
+        if (self.position and self.order is None and self.stop_price is not None
+                and float(self.data.low[0]) <= self.stop_price):
+            self.order = self.close()
+            return
+
+        minutes_from_open = (dt.hour * 60 + dt.minute) - (9 * 60 + 30)
+        bucket = minutes_from_open // 5
+        if self.five_minute_bucket is None:
+            self.five_minute_bucket = bucket
+        elif bucket != self.five_minute_bucket:
+            self._complete_five_minute_bar(
+                self.bucket_close, self.bucket_low, self.bucket_volume)
+            self.five_minute_bucket = bucket
+            self.bucket_volume = 0.0
+            self.bucket_low = None
+        self.bucket_close = float(self.data.close[0])
+        bar_low = float(self.data.low[0])
+        self.bucket_low = bar_low if self.bucket_low is None else min(self.bucket_low, bar_low)
+        self.bucket_volume += float(self.data.volume[0])
